title: evaluator's result
description: What an evaluator hands back, beside its Cut at .rn/<run>/rounds/<n>/evaluator-<group>.json: each condition of its group answered as the deliverable's people meet it.

good.description: Each condition the deliverable meets for its people, with the lines that meet it, as path:line.

more.description: Each condition not yet good, with good_when: what its people get once it's good, never how to make it.
